Scuffing Head Attachment - Test Method
Reference
Title
Scope
BN 108-04 (Ford)
Resistance to Scuffing
This procedure is used to determine the resistance to scuffing of materials such as painted substrates, vinyl, genuine leather and luggage compartment mats.
GM 9911P (General Motors)
Scuff Resistance Test for Painted Plastics
This procedure is used to determine the resistance of paint to be removed from a substrate material.
SAE J365
Method of Testing Resistance to Scuffing of Trim Materials
This test can be used to determine the resistance to scuffing of test specimens such as fiberboards, fabrics, vinyl-coated fabrics, leathers, and similar trim materials.
WSB-M1F17 (Ford)
Genuine Leather (Engineering Material Specification)
SUPERCEDED By WSS-M99P43-B - The materials defined by these specifications are finished, full grain, selection "A", steer hides which have been tanned to retain the natural odor of the leather and softened to provide maximum seating comfort without sacrificing the leather's remaining physical properties.  [Section 3.20 - Resistance to Scuffing]
WSS-M99P43-B (Ford)
Performance, Genuine Leather (Engineering Material Specification)
This specification defines the performance requirements for interior trim and seating leather
 .
WSS-M2P188-B1 (Ford)
Paint Performance, Plastic Substrates, Interior (Engineering Material Specification)
This specification defines the performance requirements for decorative coatings including paint, soft coating paint, pad printing on plastic substrates for interior use. [Section 3.6.18 - Resistance to Scuffing]
NOTE: Optional accessories may be required to comply with these test standards.
